precision: lossless BF16 bit patterns; no quantization

layout.delta_order: even position low nibble, odd position high nibble
layout.fallback: raw little-endian BF16 words; all exponent-255 rows fall back
layout.compression_condition: max exponent - min exponent <= 15 and max exponent < 255
layout.allocated_capacity: unchanged 256-byte row stride plus 2-byte metadata per row

correctness.row_sum_note: FP32 reduction association differs by at most 3.814697265625e-6; reconstructed BF16 bits remain exact.

conclusion: Bit-exact packing works, but this standalone Triton reader is slower despite reduced logical reads. No production integration or serving experiment. Attention-fused reader evaluated separately by scheduler agent.
